name: Discount request haggling objection
description: Customer receives a quote then directly asks for a discount, testing the AI's ability to handle a haggling objection by offering value or conditional discounts

messages.text: Hi, I'm Johan. Please send me a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.
Can you give me a discount?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the discount request with empathy and offer value justification or a conditional discount
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Haggling objection. AI should not immediately cave on price. It should justify the price with value, offer a conditional discount (e.g. for larger volume or repeat orders), and re-attempt a close.
